# Mode 2: Review an Existing Epic

1. Read the epic, the template, the domain model
   `<paths.domain_model>`, and
   `.github/instructions/requirements.instructions.md`.
2. Run the checks in [checks.md](checks.md); the source types of check E are
   listed in [content-rules.md](content-rules.md#source-types).
3. Report findings in chat grouped by severity, using the chat report format
   of [checks.md](checks.md#chat-report-format). Do not modify files.
4. Offer Mode 3 for the fixable findings.

**Output:** chat report only. See [examples.md](examples.md) for a worked
review.
